desc: Ideation: initial (incorrect) bipartite reduction identified; disproved by N=4, M=4 case (expected 9, bipartite count gives 3).
Diagnose flaw: within-BFS-layer edges are permitted; graph need not be bipartite; condition is only on layer-parity totals.

Implement correct DP over BFS layer compositions with inclusion-exclusion coverage polynomials h[a][b][e], within-layer binomial polynomials, convolution across layers, multinomial vertex-assignment factors; answer[M] for M=N-1..N(N-1)/2 mod P.

Verify correctness on N=4 by hand-trace: h polynomials correct, layer compositions (1|2|1) and (1|1|1|1) give 12/9/3/0 matching sample; unique BFS layering + C(remaining,b) vertex-choice factor confirmed to count each labeled graph exactly once.
Verify N=2 edge case by hand: single edge, output "1" — correct.

Analyze runtime: pure draft likely TLEs at N=30 (~10¹⁰ ops); optimizations identified: precompute hw[a][b]=h[a][b]⊗w[b] (a,b≤15 → ~4·10⁷ ops once), per-state degree caps C(used,2), enumerate-based loops.
Produce final optimized code with hw precomputation, degree caps, and tight loops; submit as answer.
